text.label: Title
text.text: GOD IS… UNCHANGING

text.label: Point
text.text: We live in a world that is constantly changing.

text.label: Point
text.text: GOD IS UNCHANGING — HE DOES NOT CHANGE

text.label: Point
text.text: Unchanging means remaining the same — God is immutable.

text.label: Point
text.text: Because God does not change, He is faithful, trustworthy, and consistent.

text.label: Subpoint
text.text: A.W. Tozer

text.label: Description
text.text: In God, no change is possible; in man, change is impossible to escape.

text.label: Reference
text.text: Malachi 3:6 (NKJV)

text.label: Verse
text.text: For I am the Lord, I do not change; therefore you are not consumed.

text.label: Point
text.text: God is and will always be faithful, good, and true.

text.label: Reference
text.text: Hebrews 13:8 (NLT)

text.label: Verse
text.text: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today and forever.

text.label: Reference
text.text: Revelation 1:8 (NLT)

text.label: Verse
text.text: I am the Alpha and the Omega—the beginning and the end… the Almighty One.

text.label: Point
text.text: Keep turning to wonder — God wants to reveal Himself to you.

text.label: Point
text.text: Saul disobeyed God and chose his own way.

text.label: Reference
text.text: 1 Samuel 15:11 (NIV)

text.label: Verse
text.text: I regret that I have made Saul king, because he has turned away from me.

text.label: Reference
text.text: 1 Samuel 15:29 (NIV)

text.label: Verse
text.text: He does not lie or change his mind; for he is not a human being.

text.label: Point
text.text: God didn’t change — Saul changed.

text.label: Point
text.text: God does not change in His character, His purposes, or who He is.

text.label: Reference
text.text: Numbers 23:19 (ESV)

text.label: Verse
text.text: God is not man, that he should lie… will he not fulfill it?

text.label: Point
text.text: Because God doesn’t change, we can trust that He is always faithful.

text.label: Reference
text.text: 2 Timothy 2:13 (NLT)

text.label: Verse
text.text: If we are unfaithful, he remains faithful.

text.label: Point
text.text: Because God doesn’t change, we can trust that He is always good.

text.label: Reference
text.text: Psalm 119:68 (NIV)

text.label: Verse
text.text: You are good, and what you do is good.

text.label: Reference
text.text: Psalm 34:8 (NKJV)

text.label: Verse
text.text: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the one who trusts in Him.

text.label: Point
text.text: We can experience God’s goodness daily.

text.label: Point
text.text: Because God doesn’t change, He is power and authority — and this never changes.

text.label: Point
text.text: The power of the Holy Spirit is here to set you free.

text.label: Point
text.text: You can change — and become more like Him.

text.label: Point
text.text: The best decision you can make is to invite Jesus into your life.

text.label: Reference
text.text: Romans 10:9 (NIV)

text.label: Verse
text.text: If you declare with your mouth Jesus is Lord… you will be saved.
